name: io.github.jordfan/gsheets-pro
description: Google Sheets for Claude Code: themed Tables, a lint and render verify loop, human-safe writes.
title: gsheets-pro

environmentVariables.name: GSHEETS_PRO_OAUTH_CLIENT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Desktop OAuth client JSON file, for Path A setup. Leave unset to fall back to gcloud Application Default Credentials (Path B). See the setup skill or docs/LIMITATIONS.md § Authentication.

environmentVariables.name: GSHEETS_PRO_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the signed-in Google credential is stored. Defaults under the server's data directory. Run `gsheets-pro auth` once to create it before adding this server to a client.

environmentVariables.name: GSHEETS_PRO_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Overrides where tokens, caches, and local renders are written. Defaults to a per-user plugin data directory.
